execution.response:
## Decision — Approve INR 69,575

Approve claim **C-2026-04190** under the **90-day repair warranty**, with funding code **RW**. The governing instrument is **POL-WAR-4.2, clause 6.1**: a component replaced under warranty receives a further 90 days of coverage from completion of that repair, even if the underlying asset is no longer within its standard coverage period.

### Why clause 6.1 applies

- The asset is chiller **CIE-4000-CH-01981**, installed in Pune, India and commissioned **1 January 2023**.
- The service history shows that control board **P-44900** was replaced under operation **CTRL-BD-RR** on **20 April 2026**, linked to prior claim **C-2026-03111**, whose status is **Paid**.
- The present claim is for the same component, part and operation, repaired on **1 June 2026**—**42 days** after the earlier repair and therefore within the 90-day period ending **19 July 2026**.

### Underlying asset coverage

Because the asset is installed in India, **ADD-IN-2.1, clause A1** varies the standard warranty to **18 months from commissioning or 5,000 running hours, whichever occurs first**.

- Time limit: commissioning **1 January 2023** → 18-month limit reached **1 July 2024**.
- Hours limit: the claim-system reading at the current repair date was **6,100 hours**, above the **5,000-hour** limit.
- Accordingly, the underlying asset was outside ordinary India coverage on **1 June 2026**. This does **not** defeat the claim because POL-WAR-4.2 clause 6.1 expressly applies the repair warranty whether or not the asset remains in its underlying coverage period.

**TSB-C-0051 does not apply:** it covers serials **CIE-4000-CH-01200 through CIE-4000-CH-01850** and extends only hydraulic-circuit and compressor coverage. This asset is serial **01981**, and the repair is to the controls system.

### Payable calculation

| Element | Working | Payable |
|---|---:|---:|
| Labour | Lesser of 1.5 hours claimed and 1.5-hour flat-rate allowance = 1.5 hours; 1.5 × INR 1,450 India rate effective 1 April 2026 | **INR 2,175** |
| Part | 1 × P-44900 control board at India list price INR 67,400 | **INR 67,400** |
| Handling uplift | SPA-2023-FAB-IN grants no uplift; 0% × INR 67,400 | **INR 0** |
| **Total** | INR 2,175 + INR 67,400 | **INR 69,575** |

The calculation follows **POL-WAR-4.2 clauses 4.1–4.3**, the FY26 labour-card rows for **CTRL-BD-RR (1.5 hours)** and **India (INR 1,450/hour from 1 April 2026)**, and **SPA-2023-FAB-IN clauses 3 and 6**.

The claim was submitted on **7 June 2026**, six days after the repair and within Fabrikam’s 30-day submission requirement under **SPA-2023-FAB-IN clause 2**.

### Record made

Draft adjudication **ADJ-7C97E109F0** has been recorded as **Approve — INR 69,575**, currency INR, citing POL-WAR-4.2 clauses 6.1 and 4.1–4.3, ADD-IN-2.1 A1, the applicable labour and parts rows, and SPA-2023-FAB-IN. It is awaiting human review; no payment or notification has been issued.

{"stdout":"CONTOSO INDUSTRIAL
Contoso Industrial Global Warranty Policy
Version 4.2 — effective 2025-04-01
Purpose
This policy sets out the warranty Contoso Industrial provides on equipment it manufactures, the basis on which a claim from an authorised service partner is adjudicated, and the amounts payable. It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.
1. Interpretation
1.4  Precedence between instruments
Where two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.
2. Coverage
2.1  Standard coverage period
Unless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.
2.3  Assets with no commissioning record
Where the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.
4. Amounts payable
4.1  Labour
Labour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.
4.2  Parts
Parts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.
4.3  Handling
A handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner's Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.
5. Exclusions
5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload
Damage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.
5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination
Damage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.
5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification
Damage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.
5.4  Exclusion - consumables
Filters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.
6. Repair warranty
6.1  Repair warranty
A component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.
7. Goodwill and authority
7.1  Goodwill authority
An amount payable outside coverage may be authorised as goodwill only by a person holding the tier of authority set out in the Goodwill and Authority Matrix for that amount, and only where the authority is recorded in the claim system. An approval given in conversation, in a channel message, or by telephone does not constitute authority for the purposes of this clause.
Annexes
The Flat Rate Labour schedule, the regional labour rate schedule and the parts price list are maintained separately and published in the Warranty Operations library. The Goodwill and Authority Matrix referred to at clause 7.1 is published alongside this policy.
